question: An engineer must automate the provisioning of Cisco ACI objects using the Terraform tool. The engineer must ensure that APIC counts the authentication login requests against the threshold to avoid a DOS attack. Which configuration must be used in Terraform to accomplish these goals?
options: resources with user ID and password
provider with user ID and password
theory: Username/password authentication in the ACI Terraform provider repeatedly requests new session tokens, and APIC counts and throttles password-based login attempts as an anti-DDoS measure (particularly from ACI 3.1 onward), which can break large-scale Terraform automation. Configuring the provider block (not individual resources) for signature-based authentication — an x509 certificate/private-key pair registered to the APIC user — avoids counting against that login threshold while also improving performance. (Cisco documentation / web research)
